question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Boys Don’t Cry’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghna Pant**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meghna Pant** is an Indian author, journalist, and speaker who wrote the book "**Boys don't cry**". 
 
• She has won a variety of awards for her contribution to **literature, gender issues, and journalism**. 
 
• In **2012**, she won the Muse India National Literary Awards Young Writer Award for her debut novel **One-and-a-Half Wife**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Zuni Chopra has 3 books on Goodreads with 448 ratings. 
 
• Zuni Chopra's most popular book is** The House that Spoke**.
 
• Young Author, Melita Tessy loves to write. 
 
• She released her first novel: **Battle of the spheres**.
 
• **Insiya Patanwala** at the age of 15 wrote the book called "**Esoterica**"
